ns2:course.label: Transport Processes in ABE
ns2:course.description: Principles of transport processes involving momentum, heat, and mass as applied to biological systems in agriculture, food, energy, and the environment. Credit is not given for both ABE 341 and CHBE 421. Prerequisite: ABE 227 and ABE 228.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given for both ABE 341 and CHBE 421. Prerequisite: ABE 227 and ABE 228.
